Get Started

Use an existing agent in your app, or build a new one. Takes 5 minutes.

Use an agent in your app

1

Pick an agent

Browse the catalog. Each agent has a detail page with a live sandbox, integration docs, and code examples.

2

Import it

Two ways — npm or ESM URL (zero install):

// npm
pnpm add @freeagentstore/resume-parser

import { parseResume } from '@freeagentstore/resume-parser'
const result = parseResume(resumeText)
— or —
// ESM URL (zero install, works anywhere)
import { parseResume } from 'https://freeagentstore.online/pkg/resume-parser/index.js'
const result = parseResume(resumeText)
3

Train it for your use case (optional)

Open the Console, upload your examples, click Evolve. Chrome's built-in AI customizes the agent for your data. Export the config and use it in your app.

import { createAgentInstance } from '@freeagentstore/sdk'
import { parseResume } from '@freeagentstore/resume-parser'
import config from './my-healthcare-parser-config.json'

const parser = createAgentInstance(parseResume, config)
parser.run(resumeText) // uses YOUR trained rules

Build a new agent

1

Decide the type

Heuristic — pure JS evolved from examples. Best for: parsing, classification, extraction, formatting.
Built-in AI — Chrome Gemini Nano with trained config. Best for: writing, summarizing, explaining.
Model-based — WebGPU/WASM inference. Best for: speech, vision, image processing.

2

Create the package

An agent is a TypeScript package that exports functions. No magic.

// packages/agents/my-agent/src/index.ts
export function myAgent(input: string): Result {
  // Your heuristic logic, or built-in AI call, or model inference
  return { ... }
}
3

Add training data + evolution loop

Use the SDK to evaluate and evolve your heuristic from examples.

import { evaluateHeuristic, buildEvolvePrompt } from '@freeagentstore/sdk'

const result = evaluateHeuristic(myCode, examples)
// { score: 0.72, passed: 36, total: 50, failures: [...] }

const prompt = buildEvolvePrompt(spec, result)
// Feed to Chrome Built-in AI or Ollama → improved code
4

Publish

Push to the FreeAgentStore monorepo. The CI builds, tests, and deploys. Your agent gets a detail page with sandbox, ESM URL, and npm package.

Connect with MCP

Manage agents from Claude, Cursor, or VS Code via the MCP server:

npx mcp-remote https://mcp.freeagentstore.online/mcp

11 tools: create_agent, write_file, read_file, list_agents, deploy_status, and more. Full docs →
